chunks: And it has been narrated: "Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, grants hajj for him and for them, and he shall have a reward for maintaining ties with them."
Whoever intends to perform tawaf on behalf of another should say when beginning the tawaf: "O Allah, accept from so-and-so," and he names the one on whose behalf he is performing tawaf.

key_terms.أَجْرٌ: reward from Allah for the act performed
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah, opening word of supplication
key_terms.تَقَبَّلْ: accept, meaning accept the devotional act
key_terms.حَجًّا: hajj, the pilgrimage reward granted in this context
key_terms.لِصِلَتِهِ: for his maintaining connection or kindness toward them

ai.seo_question: What should someone say when performing tawaf on behalf of another person?
ai.summary: This narration states that Allah grants the reward of hajj to the one who includes others in it, and also grants that person an additional reward for their kindness and maintaining ties. It also gives a practical ruling for one performing tawaf on behalf of another: at the start, one should supplicate that Allah accept it from the named person.
